conclusion: Four simple weather-tool calls returned expected structured arguments and one solid-red image was identified correctly. OpenCode 1.19.5 located and read a local fixture and returned its secret word, but repeated 4K-context compaction continued after the answer; the experiment was manually stopped. A handful of requests cannot establish stability, real coding performance, safety, or VRAM peaks.
next: Test longer contexts, coding tasks, concurrent voice services and more requests; investigate GPU memory measurement.

conclusion: The WebSocket sidecar streamed partial French transcripts and exactly recovered one locally synthesized test phrase while replaying it at real-time speed. This does not establish microphone behavior, accuracy over a representative corpus, or end-to-end voice latency.
